text:
emily_fin: Noticed a tagging regression for May that routed ~8.9k in GPU spend to `research-sandbox` instead of Platform/Search. The policy from the March cost-sharing memo says split should be 60/40 (Platform/Search). Requesting retro allocation + ledger entries.

raj_ops: Do we have the exact ingestion window? I can run a targeted re-ingest if we can provide instance IDs or a date range.

emily_fin: Ingestion gap looks like 2024-05-07 03:00 -> 2024-05-09 15:00 UTC. Full export uploaded: gs://billing-backfills/2024-05-realloc-research-sandbox.csv

emily_fin: Example rows:
```
instance_id,usage_hours,orig_label,new_allocation
nimbus-22,48.0,research-sandbox,platform:0.6;search:0.4
gpu-batch-004,6.5,research-sandbox,platform:0.6;search:0.4
```

lee_platform: Quick scan shows these were created by an automated job that used the old `owner=research` label. We pushed a fix 2024-05-09 16:20UTC but historical ingest didn't retroactively apply the new mapping.

nina_search: From product side: Search accepts the 40% retro attribution if Finance confirms no customer invoice change.

emily_fin: Customer-impact check: small number of external customers touched, estimated external credit required = $120. We're inclined to absorb via internal reserve but need formal approval from VP Finance for any customer credits.

raj_ops: Proposed reprocess command: `./bin/billing_realloc --input gs://billing-backfills/2024-05-realloc-research-sandbox.csv --policy march-2024 --apply --note "retro allocation per March memo"`

billing-bot: Billing system: reprocess job scheduled (#5402) by raj_ops. Estimated run time 45m. Output will land in gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-05-realloc-5402.csv

lee_platform: Platform lead (DM) confirmed 60/40 in thread. Also recommend adding a safeguard: in `ingest/transforms/tag_fallback.py` map `owner=research` older than 2024-05-10 to the new mapping. I'll open a small PR.

emily_fin: Requesting formal sign-off: VP Finance + Product. I emailed vp_finance@redwood.ai for the $120 credit approval path and attached the ledger impact spreadsheet.

billing-bot: Job #5402 completed. Summary: 12 instances adjusted, total reallocated = $8,934.72, customer credits flagged = $120.00. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-05-realloc-5402.csv

raj_ops: Reapply complete. I pushed the ledger diff to https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/310 with before/after rows and the audit note.

emily_fin: VP Finance responded: approve internal absorption of $120 and sign-off on reallocation. Nina, can you confirm Product approval in the PR?

nina_search: Confirmed in PR comments. Product OK with internal absorption and retro attribution.

lee_platform: PR for ingest transform opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842. Includes tests for fallback mapping.

emily_fin: Closing loop 9999999999999 : white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Ledger PR merged (#310). Accounting entries posted. Thread archived.
